issues.description: Meal constructor parameter order is inconsistent: the problem statement/UML specifies `Meal(String name, String[] ingredients)`, but the template repository defines `public Meal(String[] ingredients, String name)`. Students following the statement (and the commented Main example) will get compilation errors when using the template.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template Meal constructor signature to `public Meal(String name, String[] ingredients)` (name first), and adjust any template/example call sites accordingly.

issues.description: Contradiction in specification for SealSaloon's `stock` attribute: the UML association depicts `stock` as an instance attribute of SealSaloon (non-static), but the text explicitly requires `stock` to be static (shared across all instances) and managed by static methods. This makes it unclear whether stock is per-saloon or global.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the spec consistent: either (a) update the UML to mark `stock` as static (and keep static `acceptSupplyDelivery`/`calculateTotalPrice`), or (b) remove the static requirement from the text and make `stock` an instance field with instance methods.
